newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks set to open mixed, with downward bias.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks set to open mixed, with downward bias.

text.p: U.S. stocks look set to open mixed to slightly lower on Monday, lacking clear direction until the Federal Reserve policy-makers provide guidance on U.S. interest rates at tomorrow's meeting.

"My guess is that in anticipation of what the Fed may or may not do tomorrow, stocks will likely open mixed," James Crawford, senior vice president at Trevor Stewart Burton & Jacobsen, said. "I'd be surprised if we ended the day higher."
The long bond was trading up 1/32 at a yield of 6.90 percent compared with a yield of 6.91 percent. The Standard & Poor's Futures index was trading up 0.35 points at 832.40.
